Name: Lock Chests and Kitchens
Author: iot2026
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod allows a co-op player to claim ownership to a chest, which restrict access to only the owner, preventing others from stealing items in your chests. It also prevents other players from using your kitchen. Because a workbench pulls items from adjacent chests, the mod only allow access to workbench placed inside a house to its owner.  [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download the mod, then extract the zip file into a folder inside the Mods folder of the game. Due to how it works, make sure all players have installed the mod.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Automatically claim your chests and fridges. Normally, if you put down a chest, you will claim its ownership, unless there are other players standing near the tile you place it, so be careful. If you installed the mod after creating your world, you will claim any chest next to you. Chests in caves aren't claimable.[/*]
[*]Only you can open your chest. If a bug occurs which allows others to open your chest, the mod will disable interacting with the chest UI, effectively make it read-only.[/*]
[*]Only you can use the kitchen inside your house(s). [/*]
[*]Only you can use workbenchs inside your house(s).[/*]
[*]No configuration required.[/*]
[*]Localization support, with English and Vietnamese translation are bundled into the mod.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod only requires [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]SMAPI[/url].[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Others[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Tested on SMAPI 4.5.1 with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 build 24356 on Windows.[/color]
